title: Zesty Mustardy Lamb Stew Yorkshire
description: A hearty, comforting stew from Yorkshire, England, featuring tender lamb, a rich mustard sauce, and a creamy finish.

ingredients.name: 1 pound lamb shoulder, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces
1 teaspoon dried thyme
ingredients.notes: fresh or dried, whichever you prefer

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Reduce heat to medium and cook onion and garlic until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in mustard, horseradish, thyme, and salt; cook for 1 minute.
Add broth, water, and browned lamb; bring to a boil.
Cover pot and transfer to oven; cook for 2 1/2 hours.
Remove pot from oven and stir in flour to thicken sauce.
Return pot to stovetop and stir in single cream until heated through.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs or chives if desired.
To make lacquer glaze, mix equal parts mustard and single cream in a small bowl; brush over lamb during last 30 minutes of cooking.
